# PVC-AEAD-0 Candidate A1 / v0.2.0 Build Verification

## Environments

```text
GCC:   g++ (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0
Clang: clang version 17.0.0
```

## Results

```text
GCC 14.2 Release:       31/31
Clang 17 Release:       31/31
ASan + UBSan:           31/31
Compiler warnings:      0 observed
```

Release builds used the full 4,096-case differential budget. The sanitizer build used an explicitly bounded 256-case differential budget while running the same 31 CTest entries.

```text
GCC differential:       4096/4096
Clang differential:     4096/4096
ASan+UBSan differential: 256/256
```

## Candidate A1 freeze gates

- Canonical and independent wrappers reproduced the retained 48-vector corpus.
- 4,096 deterministic binary tuples matched at:
  - every used StreamFrame;
  - used keystream bytes;
  - ciphertext;
  - AuthContext;
  - tag;
  - canonical-open-independent-output;
  - independent-open-canonical-output.
- Seven counter boundary encodings matched in 133 selected tuples.
- Both wrappers rejected 512 changed tags, 64 wrong nonces, 64 wrong AD values, and 63 changed non-empty ciphertexts.
- The 4,096-vector differential corpus regenerated byte-for-byte.

## Retained checks

- Independent-role canonical KAT reproduced.
- 48-vector corpus regenerated byte-for-byte.
- Bounded framing audit: 24,576 stream frames plus 6,144 authentication frames, zero collisions.
- Bounded composition audit: 128 valid roundtrips and 510 nonce/AD/ciphertext/tag modifications, zero unexpected acceptances.
- Nonce-reuse demonstration reproduced the expected XOR relation.
- Complete Candidate M1/C1 dependency manifest verified without modification.

## Construction preservation

`src/aead.cpp`, the frame formats, dependency snapshots, tag computation, and retained 48-vector corpus are unchanged from v0.1.1. v0.2.0 adds an independent implementation, differential corpus, freeze documentation, and manifests.

These results establish reproducibility and wrapper agreement. They do not establish the underlying PRF assumptions or achieved security strength.
